lines_of_business: BCBSM and BCN; may be used by Medicare Advantage plans when CMS rules not fully developed (42 CFR 422.101(b)(6))
criteria_location: Inclusionary and Exclusionary Guidelines pp.2-8 (about 7 pages): initial HSAT, repeat HSAT, HSAT contraindications (footnote a), initial attended, other-disorder attended, pediatric, repeat attended, APAP contraindications (footnote d), exclusions, MSLT/MWT. 40-page document; Rationale and references are the rest.
procedures_covered: Initial attended PSG (adult OSA, adult other disorders, pediatric)
MSLT and MWT (narcolepsy, idiopathic hypersomnia, occupational safety)
Not covered: pulse oximetry alone, type IV devices (<=3 parameters)

logic.top_level: pathways with inclusions and exclusions per test; HSAT 'Both 1 and 2 must be met' where 1 is any-of/2-of groups and 2 is a NOT of a long contraindication list

k_of_n.quote: A combination of at least 2 of the following: Excessive daytime sleepiness ...; Habitual snoring ...; Treatment-resistant hypertension ...; Obesity ...; Craniofacial or upper airway soft tissue abnormalities
1a. Observed apneas OR 1b combination of at least 2 OR 1c history of stroke ... in patients who meet ONE of the criteria listed under b OR 1d. Any of the following conditions

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Footnote-style lists: 'Exclusions/Contraindications To HSAT' (about 17 items, some with sub-conditions and numeric tests) and 'Contraindications to the Use of APAP'. Referenced by letter (a, d) from other sections. 'EXCLUSIONS FOR SLEEP STUDIES' section: 'When the above criteria are met' (sic) plus oximetry and type IV devices.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Explicit separate sections for initial and repeat, HSAT and attended, adult and pediatric, MSLT and repeat MSLT.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: c. History of stroke (more than 30 days previously), transient ischemic attack, coronary artery disease, or sustained supraventricular tachycardic or bradycardic arrhythmias in patients who meet ONE of the criteria listed under "b" (above). OR
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: c requires one 'b' criterion, i.e., 1 of 5, whereas b normally requires 2 of 5: a patient with CAD plus one b item qualifies.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: EXCLUSIONS FOR SLEEP STUDIES • When the above criteria are met
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Reads as an exclusion when criteria are met - almost certainly means 'sleep studies are excluded unless/when the above criteria are not met'; a parser would invert it.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Previous 1 or 2-night home sleep apnea study did not diagnose OSA in a patient with ongoing clinical suspicion of OSA.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Listed as a HSAT contraindication, which makes a negative HSAT a bar to repeat HSAT, but the logical link to the PSG path is in a different section.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: • Periodic limb movement disorder (PLMD) when one of the following are present: pregnancy, renal failure, ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Nested condition inside a contraindication bullet.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: c. History of stroke ... OR d. Any of the following conditions which may suggest OSA when the etiology is unclear
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR chain with trailing OR; sub-bullets of b lack markers.

requirement_kinds.quote: Individuals 18 years of age or older with:
Excessive daytime sleepiness evidenced by an Epworth sleepiness >10, inappropriate daytime napping
Habitual snoring, defined as occurring every night or most nights per week
Obesity, defined as a body mass index (BMI) > 30 kg/m2 or neck circumference defined as >17 inches in men or >16 inches in women
Treatment-resistant hypertension (persistent hypertension in an individual taking three or more antihypertensive medications)
Moderate or severe chronic pulmonary disease - FEV1/FVC less than or equal to 0.7 and FEV1 less than 80% of predicted
Body mass index (BMI) greater than 33 kg/m2 and serum bicarbonate level, within the past 1-2 months, is above 28 mmol/L
The initial unattended (unsupervised) study, performed in the past 3 years, was negative, inadequate ... equivocal or non-diagnostic and clinical suspicion for OSA remains
Unsuccessful APAP titration will need to be supported by the downloaded CPAP data.
Excessive daytime sleepiness has been present for at least 8 weeks
PAP adherence as defined by CMS criteria (use of PAP for at least 4 hours per night on 70% of nights during a consecutive 30-day period)
Prior to implantation of a hypoglossal nerve stimulator (HNS) in a patient who has not had a diagnostic study (home or lab) within the preceding 18 months

thresholds.quote: >17 inches in men or >16 inches in women
FEV1/FVC less than or equal to 0.7 and FEV1 less than 80% of predicted
serum bicarbonate level, within the past 1-2 months, is above 28 mmol/L

thresholds.value: > 55 for >= 10 min, or rise > 10 to > 50 for >= 10 min
thresholds.quote: value exceeding 55 mmHg for at least 10 minutes
oxygen saturation ≤ 88% for ≥ 5 consecutive minutes of nocturnal recording time
significant weight loss (defined as 10% of body weight)
at least 50% central events or more than 5 central events per hour
at least 4 hours per night on 70% of nights during a consecutive 30-day period

time_windows.length: > 30 days ago (HSAT ok); within 30 days (HSAT contraindicated); within 90 days (CSA suspicion)
time_windows.quote: History of stroke within the preceding 30 days
undergone adenotonsillectomy ... more than eight (8) weeks previously

extraction_hazards: Footnote letters (a, b, c, d) attach lists to criteria; the footnote text appears in a later page, and the superscript is a plain letter glued to words ('HSATa', 'APAPd').
Bullet glyphs missing; nested sub-bullets lost.
Section 'EXCLUSIONS FOR SLEEP STUDIES' is split across a page break with its heading above the page number.
Typo in heading 'MUTLIPLE SLEEP LATENCY TESTING'.
40 pages: Rationale/Background/Government Regulations are long evidence reviews to skip.
interesting_structures: Three-tier structure: inclusion list, contraindication footnote, exclusions section.
Contraindication list contains compound tests (BMI>33 AND bicarbonate>28) and OHS definition with three alternative lab tests.
HSAT contraindication list includes 'Previous ... HSAT did not diagnose OSA' which routes to PSG - routing logic is expressed as a contraindication.
Pediatric repeat testing is a flat any-of list with 7 items.
MSLT/MWT criteria are fully in policy (contrast UHC delegating to InterQual).

fit_to_tree.why: Numerically explicit and mostly all/any/not, but deeply nested, footnoted, and cross-referenced contraindication lists, a 2-of-5 inside a 1-of-4, and an exclusion clause that reads inverted.
